generation.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. Asset type raw full-dressed c01 sprite source. Image 1 is the exact authoritative c01 base crop and must anchor coordinate/pose. Keep the lower pet from the helmet collar downward bit-identical in pose, scale, silhouette, fur pattern, tail, torso, legs and paws; do not redraw, resize, shift, crop or stylize it. Change only amended c01 helmet semantic zone x=31..136,y=5..126. Image 2 is only art direction for a closed white/gold retro space helmet with a filled deep-space visor, gold pods and blue integrated helmet ear fins. Fully occlude every natural pink ear inside the amended zone. Produce an independent full-dressed redraw, not an isolated accessory, mask, composite or pasted crop. Transparent background if possible; no checkerboard, black background, text, watermark or contact sheet.

steps: Read only the 1254x1254 RGB raw redraw; no prior target, mask, composite or runtime wearable was read.
Flood from the raw image border through neutral bright RGB checker pixels (chroma <= 8 and minimum channel >= 215).
Set only those reachable checker pixels to alpha 0; preserve all enclosed generated subject/helmet pixels, including white helmet highlights.
Detected generated subject crop [277,148,1007,1110), width 730 and height 962.
Resize that complete source crop to 114x150 with Lanczos3 fit-fill and place at c01 coordinate x=23,y=5 in a 160x160 RGBA normalized canvas.
Copy normalized opaque generated pixels into the amended replacement union only; keep all other base pixels byte-identical. No transform is applied after this coordinate mapping.

targetConstruction.method: Start from the original c01 base crop; copy only normalized generated pixels with alpha > 0 whose coordinates lie in the amended union; preserve base bytes outside the union.
